verdict.rationale: The pack shows Square hardware and SDK payment paths: the Terminal API, Mobile Payments SDK, Tap to Pay and the POS API. None of these items mention PCI compliance, certified or end-to-end encrypted card capture, reduced PCI scope, or vendor guidance on a developer's remaining obligations. Hardware-based card acceptance is adjacent to the story but does not evidence the PCI-scope capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep my PCI scope minimal because card data is captured end-to-end by certified readers and vendor systems, with vendor guidance on my remaining obligations
